svg.text: Perfboard, COPPER side (board turned over left-to-right, seen from below)
Columns now read L … A from left to right. North (row 1) is still at the top.
north edge: row 1, button side (north wall)
red (D0): F2–E2 (LED R → resistor); A2–A3–A4 (resistor → wire 0)
green (D2): G2–G1 (LED G → resistor); K1–J1–J2–J3–J4 (resistor → wire 2; J1, J3 are free pads)
blue (D3): G3–H3 (LED B → resistor); L3–L4 (resistor → wire 3)
ground: F3–F4 (LED cathode → wire N); E4–F4 (button wire S)
Grey = solder link between neighbouring pads (bent lead or tinned offcut). r = resistor lead. Every other pad stays bare.
R, G, C, B are neighbours: never bridge them. Trim leads ≤ 0.5 mm, then one layer of Kapton tape over the whole side (it faces the cell).
